info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Organization Direction API
info.description: The Organization Direction API provides insights into the strategic direction of organizations within the banking sector. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve current organizational strategies and their implications for business control. It is designed for banking professionals and analysts who need to assess organizational alignment with business goals. Typical use cases include performance evaluation, strategic planning, and risk management analysis, facilitating data-driven decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve information regarding the organization direction within the business control framework. It provides insights into the strategic alignment and governance structure of the organization.
